description:
• Brand Introduction:

AESTHETICS is a bold new Australian gym apparel brand built for those who live and breathe fitness. Designed for performance and style, our gear is made to empower individuals in and out of the gym. We’re community-driven, athlete-inspired, and committed to creating premium activewear that speaks to strength, discipline, and confidence.


• Product Description:

Our range includes high-quality compression shirts, tank tops, and oversized streetwear-inspired gym jumpers. Every piece is crafted for durability, breathability, and a flawless fit that supports performance while elevating your everyday aesthetic.


• USP (Unique Selling Point):

We combine gym-functionality with lifestyle design — our products are engineered for training but styled for the streets. Limited drops, community-focused content, and influencer-driven growth set us apart in a saturated market. High-quality, limited-quantity, always on-trend.


• Payment Terms:

Affiliates earn a commission on every sale made through their unique referral code. Payouts are processed securely and promptly via PayPal once the minimum threshold is met.


• Other Information:

We provide affiliates with all the tools needed to succeed — including high-converting content, priority access to new drops, and the chance to grow with a brand that's rapidly building a loyal following. Top-performing affiliates may be eligible for exclusive merch or campaign features.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Aesthetics! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as the merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, the affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and is bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorised to register as an affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approval or Rejection of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate links are automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on the Dashboard. If a customer both clicks on the affiliate link and uses the coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise the merchant's website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, etc., or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and Payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, and you will receive a commission amount which is calculated based on the Commission structure. The commission amount is dependent on the order value and does not include extra fees (tax, shipping cost, etc.).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details in Settings. The payment schedule will be notified on the Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. The use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy, which gives the merchant the right to review each and every referral order. The status of the commission is displayed in the Commission tab, and any paid commission will be listed on the Payment tab. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing Tool

We may share promotional media such as banners, logos, or specific collection promotions with you through the Marketing Tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code to share on affiliate channels.

5. Network

If the Network tab is activated, affiliates can invite others to become their downline affiliates. If any downline affiliate brings an order to the merchant's shop, the upline affiliate will also get a network commission, which depends on the merchant's settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share the network link, and any other affiliate who clicks on that link and signs up will become a downline affiliate.

6. Cookies

We use cookies to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies, then we can't track them and can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

The cookie duration is stated in the Affiliate registration form. The tracking duration will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or uses the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at the merchant's website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link again).

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: aestheticsapparel.au@gmail.com

8. Right to Review Sales Legitimacy

Aesthetics reserves the right to review the legitimacy of sales made using affiliate codes or links to ensure they are genuine. Affiliates found to be engaging in fraudulent activities or generating fake sales will be terminated from the program.

9. Invalid Orders/Transactions

Orders or transactions made using an individual's affiliate promo code or affiliate link will not be considered valid if the customer requests a chargeback or refund. Commissions earned on such orders will be deducted from the affiliate's account.

10. Commission Threshold and Payment Terms

Affiliates will be paid out once a month, provided they meet the $50 commission threshold. Aesthetics is not responsible for paying any transaction fees or currency exchange fees, which will be covered by the commission amount from affiliates.

11. Tax Responsibilities

International Affiliates: 
Affiliates operating outside of Australia are responsible for reporting and paying any income or tax obligations under their local laws. AESTHETICS AU is not responsible & does not withhold tax for non-residents. Affiliates should consult with their own tax advisors to understand their tax obligations.

12. Australian Affiliates:
Australian residents must provide a valid ABN (Australian Business Number) to receive the full commission amount. Affiliates without an ABN will have 47% of their commission withheld as PAYG Withholding Tax under Section 12-190 of Schedule 1 to the Taxation Administration Act 1953 (Cth).

You may be able to claim this withheld amount back as a tax credit in your annual return.

13. Governing Law and Jurisdiction

These Terms and Conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of New South Wales, Australia. Any disputes arising under or in connection with these Terms and Conditions shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of New South Wales, Australia.

14. Termination Rights

"AESTHETICS AU reserves the right to suspend or terminate any affiliate at any time without prior notice, especially for breach of terms, unethical behaviour, or misuse of brand assets."

15. Affiliate Content Responsibility

  • Affiliates are solely responsible for content they produce.

AESTHETICS AU disclaims liability for affiliate-created materials.


16. Amendments to Terms

We reserve the right to update or amend these terms at any time. Continued participation in the program constitutes acceptance of changes.

17. Affiliate Eligibility

By joining the AESTHETICS AU Affiliate Program, affiliates confirm that they are 18 years of age or older. If you are under 18 years of age, you must obtain consent from a parent or guardian to participate and agree to the terms of this program 

18. Payment Fees
Affiliates are responsible for any fees associated with their commission payments, including but not limited to PayPal or bank wire transfer fees. These fees will be deducted from the affiliate’s commission. We recommend using PayPal for international payments, as PayPal fees tend to be lower compared to bank wire transfer fees.

 

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always revisit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future, and if you have any questions, you can send an email to aestheticsapparel.au@gmail.com for support.
